# sentry_organization_member (Resource)

A member of the organization. Creating it sends an invitation by email; the member is `pending` until it is accepted. Destroying it removes the member or withdraws the invitation. Put members on teams with `sentry_team_member`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sends an invitation by email.
resource "sentry_organization_member" "jane" {
  email = "jane@example.com"
  role  = "member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address to invite.

### Optional

- `role` (String) Organization role: `billing`, `member`, `admin`, `manager` or `owner`. Defaults to `member`. Sentry only lets a personal token change the role of an existing member, and only up to the token owner's own role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization member ID. It is not the user's ID.
- `pending` (Boolean) Whether the invitation is still waiting to be accepted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by email address or organization member ID.
terraform import sentry_organization_member.jane jane@example.com
```
